item.title: Oregon QB Moore sustained concussion on late hit; USC suspends LB Stephens for 1 game for hit
item.description: Oregon says that quarterback Dante Moore sustained a concussion in a late hit by linebacker Desman Stephens during the second quarter of the Ducks’ victory over Southern California on Saturday

item.title: Jackson's pass, alert timeout call lead to Loop's 56-yard field goal as Ravens beat Cowboys 34-31
item.description: Lamar Jackson completed a 27-yard pass to Zay Flowers and alertly called a timeout with 1 second left, setting up Tyler Loop’s 56-yard field goal to cap a stunning 7-second drive that gave the Baltimore Ravens a 34-31 victory over the Dallas Cowboys in Brazil

item.title: Trump said he would dine with Anthropic CEO amid mounting AI debate
item.description: President Donald Trump had plans to dine late Sunday with the CEO of Anthropic

item.title: Taylor Swift becomes most-awarded artist in MTV VMAs history, dedicates top prize to Dolly Parton
item.description: Taylor Swift made history and Nirvana was awarded the 2026 Video Vanguard Award at the starry MTV Video Music Awards

item.title: Calypso icon Slinger Francisco, dubbed 'The Mighty Sparrow,' dies at 91, his family says
item.description: Calypso music has lost one of its most emblematic voices with the death of Slinger Francisco, who was known on stage as the Mighty Sparrow and dubbed the “Calypso King of the World.”

item.title: 'Avengers: Endgame' retakes box office crown; Robert Pattinson drives sales for 'Primetime'
item.description: Seven years after becoming the second-highest grossing film ever, “Avengers: Endgame” returned to the No. 1 spot at the box office in a victory lap for Marvel and an appetizer for the upcoming “Avengers: Doomsday.”

item.title: Russian drones pound civilian areas as Ukraine claims battlefield breakthroughs
item.description: Officials say that Russia’s round-the-clock bombardment of targets in Ukraine killed at least three civilians and wounded 41 others from Sunday to Monday

item.title: Mexico's Baja California braces for major Hurricane Polo as Hurricane Nolo still threatens Hawaii
item.description: Hurricane Nolo is moving away from the Hawaiian Islands amid a lingering threat of heavy rain and flash flooding

item.title: Hurricane Polo could cause life-threatening flooding in Mexico’s Baja California
item.description: Hurricane Polo bore down on Mexico’s Baja California peninsula, threatening high winds, floods and mudslides

item.title: Walmart says it's not using personal information to set prices as it expands digital shelf labels
item.description: Walmart is aiming to assuage customers' fears about its new pricing technology as it rolls out digital price labels at its stores

item.title: Trump administration set to roll out lower fuel economy standards for cars, light trucks
item.description: The Trump administration plans to release new fuel economy standards that would relax regulatory requirements for automakers to control pollution from gasoline-powered cars and light trucks

item.title: Surging oil prices drag US futures lower as Trump rejects Iranian proposal to open Strait of Hormuz
item.description: U.S. futures are falling as oil prices surge following President Donald Trump’s rejection of Iran’s proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz

item.title: Residents brace for a possible Russian hybrid attack on Poland's border with Ukraine
item.description: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk has warned of potential hybrid attacks from Russia on European countries supporting Ukraine, including Poland

item.title: SpaceX's supersized Starship launches toward orbit for the first time
item.description: SpaceX has launched its enormous Starship toward orbit for the first time, aiming for six full laps around Earth to prove its readiness for NASA's Artemis moon program

item.description: Nvidia has unveiled a new security platform designed to prevent AI agents from going rogue
